estimated-transaction-volume-usd.name: Estimated USD Transaction Value
estimated-transaction-volume-usd.description: The Estimated Transaction Value in USD value.

n-transactions.name: Confirmed Transactions Per Day
n-transactions.description: The number of daily confirmed Bitcoin transactions.

market-cap.name: Market Capitalization
market-cap.description: The total USD value of bitcoin supply in circulation, as calculated by the daily average market price across major exchanges.

total-bitcoins.name: Bitcoins in circulation
total-bitcoins.description: The total number of bitcoins that have already been mined; in other words, the current supply of bitcoins on the network.

n-unique-addresses.name: Number Of Unique Addresses Used
n-unique-addresses.description: The total number of unique addresses used on the Bitcoin blockchain.

n-transactions-per-block.name: Average Number Of Transactions Per Block
n-transactions-per-block.description: The average number of transactions per block.

estimated-transaction-volume.name: Estimated Transaction Value
estimated-transaction-volume.description: The total estimated value of transactions on the Bitcoin blockchain (does not include coins returned to sender as change).

output-volume.name: Output Value
output-volume.description: The total value of all transaction outputs per day (includes coins returned to the sender as change).

trade-volume.name: USD Exchange Trade Volume
trade-volume.description: The total USD value of trading volume on major bitcoin exchanges.
